sentences.text: When rescuers arrive, follow their instructions exactly.
They may ask you to hold a certain course and speed.
Before a helicopter arrives, secure loose gear, canvas and antennas that its rotor wash could blow around.
Let the rescue basket or hook touch the water or deck before anyone touches it, because it carries a powerful static charge.
Never tie the hoist cable to your boat.
Keep everyone in life jackets, and have a light, flare or signal mirror ready to help them find you.
